text.title: 展厅窗外的船
text.situation:
河对岸，一座小旅行展厅位于港湾上方。林把外套留在衣帽间，走上楼。窗外停着一艘货船，更远处，一艘邮轮正准备离开。展板把邮轮的豪华舱房与一艘早期研究船小得多的空间作比较。玛雅在一张标有南极路线的地图旁停下。

一次研究之旅
这次考察带研究人员沿海岸行进，收集观测资料。领航员记录位置与航向变化。天气延误了几次登岸，船员有时必须在船上等候。照片与日记页陈列在下一处展柜。

玛雅：这条路线横穿整片大陆。
林：那是陆路旅程，不是海上路线。
玛雅：想想带着所有必需品行走。
林：我会先从小一点的旅程开始。不过我想知道他们为什么选这条路。

paragraphs.en: Across the river, a small travel gallery stood above the harbour. Lin left her coat in the cloakroom and went upstairs. A cargo vessel lay beyond the window; farther out, a cruise ship was preparing to leave. A display compared its luxurious cabins with the much smaller space on an early research boat. Maya stopped beside a map marked with a route into the Antarctic.

paragraphs.en:
A research journey
The expedition took researchers along the coast, where they collected observations. The navigator kept a record of positions and changes of course. Weather delayed several landings, and the crew sometimes had to wait aboard. Photographs and diary pages are shown in the next case.

paragraphs.en:
Maya: This route crosses a whole continent.
Lin: That’s an overland journey, rather than a sea route.
Maya: Imagine carrying everything you need.
Lin: I’d start with something smaller. But I want to know why they chose that route.

S07.R03.P01.cue: 描述窗外两艘船，以及一艘船的住宿。
acceptableAnswers: 那里有一艘货船和一艘有豪华舱房的邮轮。

S07.R03.P02.cue: 告诉访客上楼前把外套放哪里。
acceptableAnswers: 可以把外套留在衣帽间。

S07.R03.P03.cue: 解释考察旅程的目的及一位船员的职责。
acceptableAnswers: 科学考察带研究人员沿海岸行进。领航员记录船的位置。

S07.R03.T01.cue: 有人问计划中的旅程是否坐船穿越大陆。澄清路线。
acceptableAnswers: 这是横穿大陆的陆路旅程，不是海上路线。
